summary: Updated thunderbird package fixes security vulnerabilities
details:
Displaying a message could load an attacker-chosen URL through an
OpenPGP key attachment. (CVE-2026-118174)
Content of other messages could be included when replying to a crafted
message. (CVE-2026-118175)
Bypass of remote UNC path restriction in mailbox: URLs.
(CVE-2026-118176)
Calendar discovery accepted local file and remote network share
locations. (CVE-2026-118177)
RSS feed could redirect its subscription to a local file or network
share. (CVE-2026-118178)
Request forgery via news: links. (CVE-2026-118179)
Matrix homeserver could redirect the chat session to a local file or
network share. (CVE-2026-118180)
Integer overflow in libmime buffer growth could lead to heap corruption.
(CVE-2026-110247)
